features: raw30 + returned64 + exactly four fixed physical interactions
fit_objective: equal-network final squared mean residual; sigma squared weights normalized by training mean
score: equal-network mean log final-MSE ratio vs unchanged parent; float64 correction then original max0 and float32 output
selection: minimum CV mean log ratio among grid and baselinezero; stable ties prefer zero then larger ridge; negative required
final_fit: selected ridge once on all32; no model selection after independent fresh
promotion: CV is training evidence only; independent fresh24 required
network_sigma_mean: Computed separately inside each network from its supplied sigma; no targets or other networks.
w1: Existing centered/scaled W^2 moment; not raw W2sum.
